name: Run code
summary: !run code in 80+ languages right in chat, on a Piston server. Edit your message to run it again.
description:
Run code is engineer-man's piston-bot for Vectiq. Type !run and a language, then your code in a code block, and the bot answers with the output, the exit code and how long it took. Lines between the command and the block are command-line arguments; lines after it are standard input. You can attach a source file instead (the extension picks the language), or reply !run to someone's message that has a code block. C, C++, Go, Java, Rust, Scala and C# get their main() added when you leave it out. Edit your message and the answer updates; delete it and the answer goes too. !langs lists the languages, !rundel removes your last answer. Output is limited to 30 lines, and each person gets a few runs a minute.

The code runs on a Piston server, never on the bot's computer. Piston's public server has been whitelist-only since February 2026, so run your own: docker run -d --privileged -p 2000:2000 ghcr.io/engineer-man/piston, install the languages you want with its CLI, then set Piston server to http://localhost:2000/api/v2/piston. If you have a whitelisted key, put it in .env as PISTON_API_KEY. This module runs Python, so it needs Settings → Marketplace → Allow modules with code.
author: engineer-man, lucky-edgelord
